flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (10.5% vs -1.6%): operating leverage
Operating margin up 200 bps over 3 years
Cash conversion strong: 5y operating cash = 245% of profit
Cash cycle tightened by 22 days in 2 years (78 → 56)

guidance.promise: UK business to exit FY2026 on an EBITDA breakeven run rate
guidance.quote: we still want to ensure that the FY2026 exit in 4Q is on a breakeven. That's actually the focus there.
guidance.speaker: Koushik Chatterjee

guidance.promise: Contain debt by Rs 6,000 to Rs 8,000 crores for FY2026
guidance.quote: our enterprise strategy to contain debt by about Rs 6,000 to Rs 8,000 crores is not getting deprioritised.
guidance.speaker: Koushik Chatterjee

guidance.promise: India net realisations about Rs 2,000 per ton lower in Q2 vs Q1
guidance.quote: the guidance we're giving for India is that the net realisations will be about Rs 2,000 per ton less in 2Q as compared to 1Q.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

claims.claim: Delivered traceable cost transformation improvement of about Rs 2,900 crores across three main geographies
claims.quote: we have delivered a traceable improvement of about Rs 2,900 crores across the three main geographies

claims.claim: Consolidated revenues stood at Rs 53,178 crores and EBITDA at about Rs 7,480 crores for 1Q
claims.quote: The consolidated revenues for the quarter stood at Rs 53,178 crores, and the EBITDA was about Rs 7,480 crores.

claims.claim: Tata Steel UK halved its EBITDA loss in the first quarter
claims.quote: In the first quarter, Tata Steel UK has managed to halve its EBITDA loss despite the challenging market conditions and the uncertainty on tariffs.

pushback.topic: UK safeguard quotas and tariff uncertainties
pushback.quote: Given there is a different process, now you're starting construction after approvals, how should we, let's say, the company does get approval by October.

pushback.topic: Reconciliation of cost savings against flat EBITDA performance
pushback.quote: How will we triangulate this? And where do we see these cost savings really getting reflected.

calls.tone: Confident yet cautious due to complex regional trade flows, volatile steel prices, and policy/tariff headwinds.

guidance.promise: Deliver half a million tons more volume in 3Q than in 2Q for India
guidance.quote: India will have half a million tons more volume in 3Q than in 2Q.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

guidance.promise: Aim to complete the Neelachal project within 3 to 4 years post-board approval
guidance.quote: The timeline that you said, yes, post-board approval, 3 to 4 years, certainly we want to complete the Neelachal project before that and try and see if we can do it faster.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

guidance.promise: Maintain Net Debt to EBITDA between 2.75 and 3 on a sustained basis
guidance.quote: between 2.75 and 3 is where would like to maintain ourselves on a more sustained basis.
guidance.speaker: Koushik Chatterjee

claims.claim: Consolidated revenues stood at Rs 58,689 crores, up 10% QoQ
claims.quote: consolidated revenues stood at Rs 58,689 crores, up 10% QoQ

claims.claim: Global cost transformation program delivered around Rs 5,450 crores in the first half
claims.quote: achieved in the first half and as highlighted on Slide 13 of the presentation, this translates to about 94% compliance to the 1H plan.

claims.claim: Consolidated Net debt stands at Rs 87,040 crores with net debt to EBITDA at 3x
claims.quote: Net debt stands at Rs 87,040 crores. Our Net debt to EBIDTA stands at 3x on a consolidated basis.

pushback.quote: given all the uncertainty and volatility that we are seeing in UK and Europe, how confident are we of the level of profitability once the EAF comes in?

pushback.topic: Iron ore security and captive sourcing strategy
pushback.quote: How are you kind of thinking about securing iron ore for Indian assets? I think in the last call you did speak about it a bit...
the amount which we are paying is seems to be much higher if I look at on the profitability basis. So, how can we explain that?

calls.tone: Cautious regarding global headwinds and UK market pressures, but confident in Indian volume growth and cost transformation.

guidance.promise: Expect EBITDA to be better in Q4 compared to Q3.
guidance.quote: So overall we expect EBITDA to be better in Q4 compared to Q3, and volumes to be almost half a million tons better in Q4 compared to Q3.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

guidance.promise: Expect volumes to be almost half a million tons better in Q4 compared to Q3.
guidance.quote: So overall we expect EBITDA to be better in Q4 compared to Q3, and volumes to be almost half a million tons better in Q4 compared to Q3.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

guidance.promise: Expect an EBITDA expansion in Netherlands in Q4.
guidance.quote: we expect Netherlands to more than offset this reduction in realisations because of cost take out, so we expect an EBITDA expansion in Netherlands, and a slight improvement in EBITDA in UK.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

guidance.promise: Net debt to EBITDA remains within the stated range of below 3x for the cycle.
guidance.quote: Our net debt to EBITDA stands at about ~2.6x, well within the stated range of below 3x for the cycle.
guidance.speaker: Koushik Chatterjee

guidance.promise: Aim to double the profitability of the color coated business in the next year or two.
guidance.quote: So, there are many options that we have, and our aim is to actually double the profitability of the business in the next year or two.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran

claims.claim: Consolidated EBITDA increased 31% YoY to Rs. 24,894 crores in nine months.
claims.quote: consolidated EBITDA increased by 31% YoY from Rs. 19,040 crores in the nine months ended December 2024 to Rs. 24,894 crores in the nine months ended December 2025.

claims.claim: Cost transformation program achieved Rs. 8,600 crores of savings in nine months.
claims.quote: demonstrates the impact of the cost transformation program, which has achieved Rs. 8,600 crores of savings in the nine months across geographies.

claims.claim: India quarterly deliveries past 6 million tons for the first time.
claims.quote: taking quarterly deliveries past 6 million tons for the first time for Tata Steel in India.

claims.claim: Net debt reduced by Rs. 5,200 crores versus previous quarter to Rs. 81,834 crores.
claims.quote: Net debt at Rs. 81,834 crores was lower by about Rs. 5,200 crores vs. the end of the previous quarter in Sep’25

pushback.topic: UK operational losses and lack of policy support
pushback.quote: The losses in the UK operations are relentless, and there does not seem to be any policy support coming through.

pushback.topic: UK capital expenditure continuation despite EBITDA losses
pushback.quote: So would the company at some point of time wait for the policy to fructify before stepping upon the capex or will the capex continue

pushback.topic: India capacity headroom and potential market share loss
pushback.quote: is a market share loss over the next few years, a point of worry or consideration for us in evaluating all the expansion plans?

calls.tone: Confident and pragmatic, highlighting cost efficiencies and regulatory transformations in Europe and India.

guidance.promise: Increase capex to around Rs 20,000 crores in FY2027 with over 60% spent in India
guidance.quote: we intend to increase the same in FY2027 to around Rs 20,000 crores of which more than 60% will be spend in India.
guidance.speaker: Koushik Chatterjee: ED & CFO

guidance.promise: Volume to be at least 2 million tons better in FY2027 compared to previous year
guidance.quote: So, we expect it to be 2 million tons plus for this financial year compared to the previous financial year.
guidance.speaker: T. V. Narendran: CEO & MD

guidance.promise: Target cost transformation related savings of around Rs 7,100 crores in FY2027
guidance.quote: In FY2027 we are aiming to achieve cost transformation related savings of ~Rs 7,100 crores vs. FY2026 levels.
guidance.speaker: Koushik Chatterjee: ED & CFO

claims.claim: Consolidated EBITDA increased by 35% YoY to Rs 34,848 crores for FY2026
claims.quote: Our Consolidated EBITDA increased by 35% YoY from Rs 25,802 crores in the full year ended Mar’25 to Rs 34,848 crores in the full year ended Mar’26.

claims.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded by 320 bps to around 15%
claims.quote: The consolidated EBITDA margin expanded by 320 bps from ~12% to ~15%.

claims.claim: Cost transformation program achieved Rs 10,868 crores of savings across geographies
claims.quote: This performance demonstrates the impact of the cost transformation program, which has achieved Rs 10,868 crores of savings across geographies.

claims.claim: Prepaid around Rs 9,100 crores of debt from internal cash over the last 12 months
claims.quote: in the last 12 months we have actually prepaid around Rs 9,100 crores of debt from our internal cash during the year.

pushback.topic: Netherlands coke and gas plants closure and going concern uncertainty
pushback.quote: So, are we saying that there's not much cost impact?

pushback.topic: India capacity growth pace compared to aggressive competitor additions
pushback.quote: And generally, as we're seeing a lot of players adding capacity aggressively, looks like, at least from the map, that we might lose market share over next 5-7 years.

pushback.topic: Capital allocation and hesitation on parallel expansion in India
pushback.quote: Why can't we have parallel expansions across our projects? Brownfield expansions... and of course, not seeding the market share to the peers. Why are we not pursuing that?

calls.tone: Confident, transparent, and measured regarding operational headwinds and long-term strategic optionality.

promise_ledger.delivered: Borrowings fell from Rs94,801 crore (FY25) to Rs92,382 crore, a Rs2,419 crore drop, short of the Rs6‑8k target
promise_ledger.quote: our enterprise strategy to contain debt by about Rs 6,000 to Rs 8,000 crores is not getting deprioritised.

promise_ledger.promise: Maintain Net Debt/EBITDA between 2.75‑3 on a sustained basis
promise_ledger.delivered: Net debt Sep 2026 Rs102,368 crore ÷ EBITDA Rs10,533 crore ≈9.7x, far above the 2.75‑3 range
promise_ledger.quote: between 2.75 and 3 is where would like to maintain ourselves on a more sustained basis.

credibility.line: Management repeatedly overshoots debt and EBITDA targets, undermining credibility.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Guidance of breakeven UK EBITDA and debt cuts clash with rising net‑debt ratio (~9.7x) and no UK segment data.
Cost‑transformation claims (Rs10,868 crore FY2026) contrast with modest EBITDA growth (31% YoY) and still‑high debt.
Operating margin improved to 15% FY2026, matching the narrative of margin expansion.

bull: EBITDA rose 31% YoY to Rs24,894 crore in nine months (Q3 FY26).
EBITDA margin reached ~15% FY2026, up 320 bps.
Cost‑transformation savings hit Rs10,868 crore FY2026.
bear: Net debt rose to Rs102,368 crore, net‑debt/EBITDA ~9.7x, far above the 2.75‑3x target.
EBITDA fell in Q4 FY26 versus Q3, missing the improvement promise.
Debt‑containment fell short by ~Rs4‑6 billion versus the Rs6‑8 billion goal.
watch: Quarterly EBITDA trend after Q4 FY26.
India volume growth versus promised half‑million‑ton lifts.
